say about my one of the project

One of your projects is the **Mobile Price Prediction Model**, completed in June 2025.

Key details about this project include:
*   **Objective:** Designed and deployed a mobile price classification model.
*   **Methodology:** Utilized K-Nearest Neighbors for the classification.
*   **Performance:** Achieved 93.5% accuracy on unseen test data and 94.6% on training data, demonstrating balanced class performance.
*   **Data Handling:** Involved data preprocessing and Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) on 2,000 samples with 21 features. This included train-test split, normalization, and batch prediction on over 1,000 new entries.
*   **Technologies:** Python and Machine Learning (ML) were used.

Based on the provided documents, here are details about the other projects:

1.  **Time-Series Forecasting for Stock Markets using Deep Learning**
    *   **Completion Date:** August 2025
    *   **Technologies:** Python, Deep Learning (DL), LSTM, Streamlit
    *   **Description:** This project involved developing and deploying a web application for stock analysis and forecasting. It uses Streamlit, TensorFlow/Keras, and Plotly to visualize over 10 financial indicators (e.g., candlesticks, moving averages, return heatmaps, cumulative returns). An LSTM-based time-series prediction pipeline was implemented with Min-Max scaling and a 100-day lookback window to generate 10-day forward stock price forecasts, utilizing real-time data from the Yahoo Finance API.
    *   **Website:** https://stock-prices-prediction.streamlit.app/
    *   [Document 4 from uploads/08e66003-836b-4864-87a5-191ea9522067_Abhisek Patra ICIC.pdf (Page 1)]

2.  **Multi-Disease Prediction System**
    *   **Completion Date:** July 2025
    *   **Technologies:** Python, Machine Learning (ML), Streamlit
    *   **Description:** A unified multi-disease prediction system was built and deployed. It uses Support Vector Machine (SVM) models for Diabetes and Parkinson’s disease prediction, and Logistic Regression for Heart Disease prediction. The system achieved accuracies of 78.57% for Diabetes, 88.46% for Parkinson’s, and 85.25% for Heart Disease on benchmark datasets. The ML models were integrated into a full-stack Streamlit web application using Python, scikit-learn, joblib, and Streamlit-option-menu, and deployed on Streamlit Cloud with modular routing and real-time user interaction.
    *   **Website:** multi-disease-prediction-3model.streamlit.app
    *   [Document 5 from uploads/08e66003-836b-4864-87a5-191ea9522067_Abhisek Patra ICIC.pdf (Page 1)]
